en: Live yer own life. It ain't like everyone's gotta do things by a certain time.
I used to think the same thing, but now I guess I was wrong.
It's not just high schoolers making their debuts in show biz now. It starts with middle and grade school aged kids. After twenty, it's too late.
Bein' recruited that young is rough. I bet only a small handful are able to stick it out.
I'm not sure I'd be able to make any of my dreams come true in my late twenties, even if I tried my best at it.
It is what it is. Not everybody has dreams. And only a few people even realize their dreams.
So then I should just keep bouncing around from job to job until I find someone to settle down with, get married, and become a housewife?
What's wrong with that? Ya could get married, have kids, and build a happy family. Be an upstandin' member of society. I can't do that.
Yeah, I guess our values are different. I don't think of that as contributing to society. Or maybe I just don't want to do it.
I wish the world was a kinder place to people who don't work or aren't married.
Guess I'm old-fashioned that way.
That ain't it. Ya shouldn't live yer life worried about if everythin's right or wrong.
Even if others are against ya, livin' yer life with conviction is the best way to live without regret.
When you say it like that, it sounds kind of cool to go against the grain. I kind of want to follow your example, Saejima-san!
Maybe it's okay if I don't have any big goals.
I think ya oughta give it some real thought.
Don't give up. There's things only you can do. Bein' in yer late twenties, ya can do stuff no brat in their teens could pull off.
I had to wait patiently for 25 years. There are flowers that can bloom at 45. It's never too late to dream.
Maybe I should try to find something that I'm capable of doing now.
I've only thought about what I want to do. I should consider things that I <Italic>can</Italic> do!
Thanks for the advice, Saejima-san!
But you said I was a disappointment to my parents, Saejima-san. I guess I really can't just drift around without a plan.
Right, that's not a good idea.
So I've looked into things a bit more, and I can't find any jobs I'd be good at doing.
No jobs, huh? How come?
I'm either outside of the age range they're hiring for, or I don't have enough experience.
I see. I guess we're still in a recession.
So it's just going to be tough to find a job, isn't it?
Don't give up. You'll never accomplish anythin' if ya give up that easily.
Yeah, I was thinking of looking a little more.
There was one thing that looked kind of promising. It was an audition for models.
They said they needed girls between eighteen and 25. And I turned 26 last month.
That's too bad. If only ya'd gotten yerself in a little sooner.
That's been happening to me a lot lately. If only I'd done such-and-such a little earlier. I'm full of regrets...
There'll be others. Lotsa places'll be hirin' after the new year, right?
Sure, but they'll have the same requirements and I'll keep getting older. So it's not like I can just wait until next year.
I see. Chances are gonna be gettin' fewer and fewer, huh?
Well, ya can't do anythin' about yer age. Ya need to better yerself. If a rare chance does come by, ya need to be able to take it.
Will a chance like that really come?
It will. Effort is bound to pay off in time.
It's reassuring to hear you say that!
I've had my own string of failures in life.
But I got to where I am now by not lettin' the few chances I had slip me by, and by havin' someone who trusted me enough to wait.
Hmm. In that case, I'll have to do my best to live up to your expectations of me, Saejima-san!
Heh. Ya've got my support.
Look for other options. If yer outlook's too narrow, you'll never know when a good chance comes yer way.
Good point. I should think a little more about what sort of things I can do!
Yeah. Chances don't come along just by waitin'. Ya need to get out there and grab 'em.
Will do!
So lie about yer age. A single year ain't gonna be a big deal.
What? I can't do that. They went out of their way to put strict age limits.
Ya don't think you can make it?
Well, I mean... What if I blow it because I get caught in my lie?
If ya don't have the chops, it won't matter how old you are. First, you should try applyin' to see if ya even got what it takes.
Oh, that's a good point. Then if I don't get it, it won't be because of my age.
Don't worry 'bout that. Everyone does that sorta thing from time to time.
Yeah. Even lyin' to achieve yer dreams shows ya really want it. If ya hesitate 'cause of yer age, it'll only hold ya back.
If ya really wanna do somethin', then ya've gotta be willin' to try any and everything.
You're right. I don't want to give up before I've even tried. If my application fails, I can accept that.
That settles it! I'm going to get out there and try out for this audition!
Good. The real battle starts now.
Well, this has turned into a giant pain...
That arranged marriage thing from before.
Ah, that. How'd it wind up goin'?
I was told to go with the flow for the sake of the suitor, and that it was okay for me to turn him down if I didn't like him.
Don't you think that's just a waste of time?
Yeah. It ain't fair to the other person if ya go to a marriage meetin' ya've got no interest in seein' through.
Right? I said the same thing, but they still insisted it was fine and that I come anyway.
It's good to talk to new people. It's not like ya can flat-out tell yer parents no when ya haven't even met the guy.
But I'd feel worse turning him down after we meet! I don't want to get his hopes up or anything.
Then why not go and tell yer parents what ya really wanna do?
Well, it's not just the arranged marriage that's the problem. I also don't want to go back to my parents' house.
Because I'm afraid I'll get too comfortable there and wind up staying.
I get that. I ain't exactly the lonesome sort. I feel better havin' people around than I do bein' alone.
But moving back in with my parents feels kind of like giving up on my own life.
I'm going to hear all about my classmates who are married, and since mooching off my parents just makes me feel guilty, I might start thinking about marriage too.
Are ya homesick? That ain't like you.
It's the other way around! I don't want to go back home!
I live my life free from hassles like finding a job or getting married, so I'm not going to let my parents dictate how I live my life now.
So whaddya wanna do?
If I nail this audition, I can keep living on my own and I won't need to go back home to my parents.
Interestin'. So ya've made yer decision?
Audition?
I mentioned it before! For the modeling job.
Oh yeah, that. So yer gonna go for it.
Yes. And if I blow the audition, then I'll go back home, do what my parents tell me, and go through with this arranged marriage meeting.
So this is my first and last chance!
That's the spirit. Go into it with that attitude and yer sure to get the gig. Ya gotta forge your own destiny.
Yeah! I'm going to go and land this job!
Don't get too eager. You need to psych yourself up, but if ya overdo it, ya might blow it. Try to be yerself as much as ya can.
Good point! I'll try not to overthink this too much.
If you were there with me on audition day, I'd be able to relax a lot more, you know.
I can't make any promises...
There'll be other chances. Ya always have the option of starting yer life again. It's not like ya've only got one shot at things.
Don't talk as if I've already failed! I'm really trying to make an effort here.
That ain't what I meant...
There isn't much time left before my modeling audition. Oh, I'm super nervous!
That's fine. Bein' a little nervous will make ya do better on the big day.
You say that, but I'm going to be so nervous and stiff that I'll wind up acting like a robot!
Ya gotta relax more. Too much anxiety will make ya screw up.
I know that. That's why I'm so anxious!
Oh yeah, what happened with the age thing for that audition? Was it a no-go?
I decided to lie about my age. Unless I take a chance at this audition, I'm never going to open any doors for myself.
Go get 'em. The key to success is never givin' up.
No, this audition is my one and only shot. If I don't get it, I'm moving back in with my parents.
Yeah, ya said that.
Hope ya don't get caught. You seem like the sort who might let the wrong thing slip.
Maybe so! Like when introducing myself I'll get careless and blurt out my real age or something.
You should practice what yer gonna say.
Good idea! Thanks for the advice, Saejima-san!
How much younger did ya make yerself?
Three years! So 23!
Yeah, I guess ya look it. To be honest, I find it hard to tell with women.
I hear foreigners think Japanese women look much younger than they are! Like they might think I'm still in my teens!
Well, lyin' about yer age is one thing, but ya can't lie 'bout yer abilities. How're things goin' on that front?
No way is that gonna fly. If these guys're pros, they're gonna see right through ya.
I'll worry about that if I get caught. If it's a no-go, then that's that. If they're okay with it, then I guess I'm lucky.
I've been getting ready for the audition every day after I get home from work. I'm practicing a number of different things.
What kinda things?
I practice posing in the mirror, how to walk more elegantly, and I'm also looking into current fashion trends.
I'm used to lounging around after I get home, but now my days are so full of things to do!
Ya've gotta glow about ya. Anyone can see yer attractive right now. Ain't got anythin' to do with yer age.
You really mean it? I'm so happy to hear that!
Folks workin' towards their dreams got a special look to 'em. Yer nothin' like the old you.
Hmm. Speaking of which, what was the old me like exactly?
Heh. Gonna hafta keep that a secret.
Hey! Wait, what's that supposed to mean?
It's important to relax, too. Keepin' to yer normal pace of doin' things might help ya be yer best.
Hmm. But in my case, I don't think my normal pace is going to be enough.
I have to do whatever I can so I don't waste my one chance. I want to give this my all.
Yeah, okay. I get ya. Guess ya gotta put yer best foot forward.
Saejima-san! I've got something to tell you!
So I heard back about that audition I took the other day.
Well, so...
I passed!
Then we gotta celebrate!
Thank you so much! I owe this all to you, Saejima-san!
Yer kiddin'!
It's true! I've read the email they sent me over and over!
I see. Guess yer on the way to becomin' a rookie model now.
That's right! I've turned down the arranged marriage, and now it's time for a fresh start to get my new life on track!
Keep at it. It might be tough to get used to at first, but things oughta go fine for ya if you don't give up.
Haha! You really are like a teacher, Saejima-san! Think you might still try to be one?
Hey, might be interestin'.
Ya gonna quit yer job here?
I suppose. It looks like my time has come.
Oh? Why, Saejima-san, are you implying that you're going to miss me when I'm gone?
Nah... It ain't like that!
Did ya manage to lie about yer age?
Oh! You know, I completely forgot about that!
Heh. Go figure.
Yeah. But what if it comes up again and I run into problems over it?
Ya might have a tough road ahead.
<Color:255,200,200,255>You're so buff, Saejima-san! Just my type!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Mmhm. I'm really into martial arts! Whenever I watch fights on TV, I'm on the edge of my seat!<Color:Default>
Me too. I used to watch pro wrestlin' a lot, but I'm more into martial arts now.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah! I'm really looking forward to the New Year's Eve broadcast!<Color:Default>
Yer pretty into it, huh?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, that's not the half of it! When it comes to guys, it's all about muscles for me! Those scrawny little host types? No thank you!<Color:Default>
Hah. I see.
You can touch 'em if ya want.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Huh!? Oh, no, I... What do I do?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>If I touched you now, I'd completely lose it! Maybe next time!<Color:Default>
Hey, whenever ya like.
I wouldn't have guessed. I didn't think women were into that sorta thing.
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's not true! What's not to like about watching a bunch of guys who are practically naked?<Color:Default>
